attributes.action: Save Dans Delights Ice Cream Kiosk
attributes.additional_details:
After over six years serving the Portsmouth community, the council have taken our kiosk.
We are devastated. We’ve worked hard to improve the area, make it safer, and create a place that is loved by the community.
We are well known, well loved — and now our staff are at risk of losing their jobs too.
Please support us and help save Dan’s Delights Kiosk
attributes.background: Stop Portsmouth city council closing Dans Delights Ice Cream college park kiosk Portsmouth

rejection.details: This is a local matter, not something for which central Government is responsible.
